name: Scotiabank Gold American Express Card

apr.notes: 21.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances, balance transfers and cash-like transactions.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees; only the exchange rate applies.

credit_required.notes: Minimum personal income of $12,000 per year.

base_rate.description: 1 Scene+ point per $1 on all other eligible purchases; accelerated rates apply to purchases in Canadian currency only.

categories.label: Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, FreshCo, Foodland and other Sobeys family stores
Other grocery, dining, food delivery and food subscriptions

rewards.redemption_notes: Scene+ points redeem for travel, groceries, dining, entertainment, gift cards and statement credits against purchases.

signup_bonus.description: 30,000 bonus Scene+ points after $2,000 in everyday eligible purchases in the first 3 months.

notes: Scotiabank American Express cards carry no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
